verdict.rationale: Svelte's reactivity model uses explicit primitives ($state, $derived, $effect) with no hidden API layer — 'count is just a number' and derived/effect docs show state changes are declared and traceable rather than implicit two-way magic (svelte-docs-5,6,7,8,9,20). Community feedback corroborates predictability/readability gains over frameworks with more implicit binding models (svelte-comm-2, svelte-comm-5, svelte-comm-8), though this isn't framed specifically around 'debugging' tooling. Missing for 10: dedicated devtools/debugging story for tracing state changes at runtime, and independent hands-on evidence specifically about avoiding two-way-binding debugging pain.
